answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 23166 Country: India Title: My name in school was registered as samreen.then it changd to sabreen.n nw it is sabreena.vich 1 z correct.is there any effect of name on an individual.my parents didnt paid any attention to it. Question: My name in school was registered as samreen.then it changd to sabreen.n nw it is sabreena.vich 1 z correct.is there any effect of name on an individual.my parents didnt paid any attention to it. Answer ID: 23166 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1007/738/L=1431) (1) Sabreen is better than Samreen, however Sabreen is the masculine form, hence you should change your name from Sabreen to Sabra, it means a woman having patience. (2) Yes, names have effects on human beings. The holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) asked to choose good names and change bad names. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
